Bordeaux ( / b ɔːr ˈ d oʊ / bor- DOH ; French: [bɔrdo] ⓘ ; Gascon Occitan : Bordèu [buɾˈðɛw] ; Basque : Bordele ) is a city on the river Garonne in the Gironde department , southwestern France. A port city, it is the capital of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, as well as the prefecture of the Gironde department. Its inhabitants are called " Bordelais " (masculine) or " Bordelaises " (feminine). The term "Bordelais" may also refer to the city and its surrounding region.
